issues.title: Direct BackendProcessHost probes omitted required FD5 hydration and inherited retired authority
issues.rootCause: WP3/WP4 direct probes did not consistently declare credentialFrameRequired and inherited retired YANCE_SAFE_MODE/path authorities.
issues.fix: Require credential frame, strip retired exact keys, isolate data-root/SQLite/mutex authority and expose bounded boot diagnostics.
issues.verification: WP3 production boot passed in Batch31 Windows; full Batch36 Windows retest pending.

issues.title: Rejected-owner concurrent exit was persisted as permanent live containment
issues.rootCause: Windows FD6 close could terminate the child after stop reported failure; stale stop result was treated as authoritative.
issues.fix: Observe bounded concurrent exit, require durable owner release, keep fail-closed only while child/owner/fence remains live.
issues.verification: Batch35 A12/A14/A20/A21 4/4 PASS; full matrix pending.

issues.title: Long WP4 case identifiers caused SQLite CANTOPEN in Windows temporary paths
issues.rootCause: Full evidence case names were used as filesystem identity, producing 126–134 character database paths for the four longest cases.
issues.fix: Use short case number plus 12-character SHA256 prefix; preserve full case id only in evidence metadata.
issues.verification: Batch35 short-path contracts 6/6 and four target cases 4/4 PASS.

issues.title: SQLite ownership errors lacked bounded classification and retry
issues.rootCause: Store-open and lease-acquire failures were wrapped as generic runtime initialization errors.
issues.fix: Split ownership_store_open/ownership_lease_acquire; map fixed BOOT_SQLITE codes; retry only BUSY/LOCKED at 50/150/300ms.
issues.verification: SQLite classification/retry tests PASS; target Windows cases pass.

issues.title: Selected containment matrix represented unexecuted probes as FAIL
issues.rootCause: Grouped probe status required every full-matrix member even when a targeted case subset was intentionally selected.
issues.fix: Introduce NOT_RUN/PARTIAL semantics; selected result may be PASS with evidenceCompleteness=PARTIAL; complete PASS still requires all probes.
